name: Turn PDF invoices from Gmail into text and log them in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## PDF invoices from Gmail to text

Get the text of every PDF that arrives by email, without opening it, and keep a log of it in Google Sheets.

### How it works
1. **New email with a PDF** (Gmail trigger) watches for emails with a PDF attachment.
2. **PDF to text** (CompassLab, PDF) extracts the text of the first attachment and lists scanned pages, so you know when a document needs OCR.
3. **Log the invoice** appends one row per PDF: received, from, subject, pages, scanned pages, text.

### Set up steps (5 minutes)
1. Connect Gmail in **New email with a PDF**. The search `has:attachment filename:pdf` picks emails with a PDF; narrow it, for example `from:billing@supplier.com`.
2. Create a sheet with the columns `received`, `from`, `subject`, `pages`, `scanned_pages`, `text` and select it in **Log the invoice**.
3. In **PDF to text**, create a CompassLab credential with your api.market or RapidAPI key (both have a free plan).

### Customize
Send `text` to an AI node to pull out the invoice number, date and total.

meta.description: Extracts the text of PDF attachments from Gmail with the CompassLab node (PDF) and logs sender, subject, pages, scanned pages and text in a Google Sheet.
